title: Asymmetric Initialization 10-Layer Refinement
scientific_hypothesis: Breaking thickness initialization symmetry with alternating quarter-wave estimates will escape local optima that uniform 200nm seeding encountered, enabling the optimizer to access the remaining 0.0025 score headroom identified in iteration 1.
design_principle: Transfer matrix thickness optimization with asymmetric seed profiles reduces optimizer stagnation near convergence boundaries by providing gradient diversity across the dual-band objective landscape.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Silicon substrate (10 finite layers, 5 high-low pairs)
soft_objectives: minimize average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band
minimize average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference optimization
Asymmetric initialization breaks gradient symmetry in non-convex thickness space
expected_advantages: Escapes local optima from uniform initialization
Enables sub-nm refinement with reduced step-size
known_risks: May converge to different local optimum with similar score
Asymmetric seeds could increase optimization iterations
execution_request_english: Optimize a 10-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate. Stack sequence: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si. Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm. Incidence: 0 deg, unpolarized. Thickness bounds: 20-400 nm per layer. Initialize thicknesses with alternating quarter-wave estimates at 1310 nm and 1547.5 nm center wavelengths (not uniform 200 nm). Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step-size parameter reduced by 50% compared to iteration 1 baseline. Minimize weighted average reflectance across both bands. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to break initialization symmetry by replacing uniform 200nm seeds with randomized asymmetric quarter-wave profiles and reducing optimizer step-size by 50% for sub-nm refinement near score=1.0
